guideS1P1: The system has two separate wallets, two independent ledgers:
guideS1P2: is the engine SIM budget. Engine scans markets and opens virtual orders with this fund for AI training. Deployed/Available bar reflects this wallet only.
guideS1P3: is yours. Packages don't create new orders; they attach to engine signals and calculate your P/L = capital × order %.
guideS1P4: → Matching a package does NOT deduct from 5B. Both ledgers run in parallel.
guideS2P1: Each matched order uses exactly the capital you enter. Package completes after 1 order.
guideS2P2: You delegate a total fund; the bot sizes each order by signal strength & risk, runs multiple orders continuously. P/L compounds into the fund.
guideS2P3: Dynamic Sizing: stronger signals (higher score) → larger size; capped so each SL hit loses ~1% of total fund.
guideS3P1: Not sent to exchange. Engine tracks real prices (Binance/Entrade), calculates paper PnL with your capital. For strategy testing + AI training.
guideS3P2: Capital maps to real exchange balance (USDT or VND). When engine matches, orders are sent for real (Crypto and VN stocks via DNSE LightSpeed supported).
guideS3P3: If live fails (wrong symbol, insufficient balance) → order falls back to simulation and stays tracked.
guideS4P1: Full scan: simulated orders (background training) + LIVE orders.
guideS4P2: Stops new simulated orders. But LIVE packages and real exchange positions are STILL scanned, monitored and closed — real money is never abandoned.
guideS5P1: When creating a LIVE package, the system checks real USDT balance at registration.
guideS5P2: Total LIVE package capital on one connection cannot exceed balance. If fully delegated (ALL), next LIVE package on that connection is blocked with available balance notice.
guideS5P3: Max 5 pending LIVE orders and 5 active connections per account.
guideS6P1: Create package → Engine scans signals → Match package to suitable order → (LIVE: send to exchange / SIM: virtual tracking) → Hit TP/SL → Close order → Calculate PnL → (Portfolio: return capital + compound into fund).
guideS6P2: View real LIVE positions & exchange order log in Broker tab. Simulated orders in AI signal log.
configCollapsedDesc: Configure order quality, scan when missing orders, live order safety… saved to MongoDB (system-wide). Open panel for details.
scoringIntro: Each setup is scored by technical quality (0–100), indicator consensus, and edge. Higher scores/thresholds = harder to enter (safer); lower thresholds = more orders but higher risk. Changes apply from the next pipeline cycle.
qualityScaleDetail: max 100; very high/rare ≥ 90; common LIVE entries ~ 82–88 (default threshold 82); SIM common ~ 72–80 (default 72); weak scores usually < 70 (often filtered). Consensus: LIVE ≥3, SIM ≥2 indicators same direction. Edge: LIVE ≥28, SIM ≥22 (default).
modeBadgeLiveExplain: = real money on exchange via broker (green background).
modeBadgeSimExplain: = background simulated orders for AI training (purple background). Shared setting = default background.
searchMatchCaseTitle: Like Word: Match case off — Live = live

searchWholeWordTitle: Like Word: whole words only — match standalone words
exportLiveDataDesc: Download AutoDuck LIVE (real money) order history with exchange orders, packages and performance stats — for review, reporting or external analysis. Limit by date range (VN time) or export all. Each export includes JSON (full dump), Markdown (summary report) and Excel (6 sheets: trades, orders, packages, by symbol, equity, early/late). See {{filesSection}} below for details.

exportSheetTradesLivePurpose: Each AutoTrade LIVE order: entry/exit, PnL VND, hold time, signal breakdown, exit tag…
exportSheetExchangeOrdersPurpose: Exchange orders sent (LIVE + testnet): side, purpose, notional, fill/fail status.
exportSheetPackagesLivePurpose: LIVE UserOrder packages: capital, allocation, realized PnL, allocation count.
